drums.description: Hard rock with heavy blues influence, Distorted electric guitars play a syncopated, palm-muted riff in E minor at 120 BPM, The drum kit features a prominent open hi-hat on the off-beats and a heavy snare crack, A distorted bass guitar follows the guitar riff with occasional slides, The arrangement alternates between a driving main riff and a more open section with sustained power chords and crashing cymbals, A wah-wah pedal effect is applied to a lead guitar melody during the bridge, The production is dry with minimal reverb on the rhythm section Publish
